profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer that has worked in various technologies with an emphasis on backend development. I’ve built servers using Nodejs and Java.  Done some front end work using React and Angular. Worked with a team to construct a container orchestration platform using Kubernetes. Collaborated on implementation of HVAC protocols. Used C to create a native shared library and integrated it into Java using JNI. Also dabbled in some Kernel Programming.  Always learning and always growing.
